description: Quantify where each Nvj3 half maps onto long SNX-RGS proteins in Foldseek hits
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
R=json.load(open("foldseek_results.json"))
rows=[]
for q,res in R.items():
    for db in res.get("results",[]):
        al=db.get("alignments")
        if not al: continue
        for h in (al[0] if isinstance(al[0],list) else al):
            rows.append(dict(query=q, target=h["target"], name=h["target"].split("model_v6 ")[-1][:40],
                             dbLen=h["dbLen"], tStart=h["dbStartPos"], tEnd=h["dbEndPos"],
                             qStart=h["qStartPos"], qEnd=h["qEndPos"], eval=h["eval"], seqId=h["seqId"],
                             tax=h.get("taxName"), relmid=(h["dbStartPos"]+h["dbEndPos"])/2/max(1,h["dbLen"])))
d=pd.DataFrame(rows); d.to_csv("foldseek_hits.csv",index=False)
LONG=d[d.dbLen>700]
print("Foldseek hits, targets >700 aa (SNX-RGS / Mdm1-like architecture):")
for q in d["query"].unique():
    s=LONG[LONG["query"]==q]
    print(f"  {q}: n={len(s)}, median relative position of alignment midpoint in target = {s.relmid.median():.2f} "
          f"(IQR {s.relmid.quantile(.25):.2f}-{s.relmid.quantile(.75):.2f})")
from scipy import stats
a=LONG[LONG["query"]=="NVJ3_Cterm_254_463"].relmid; b=LONG[LONG["query"]=="NVJ3_PXAmod_61_253"].relmid
if len(b)>1:
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater"); print(f"  C-term maps further C-terminal than PXA module: U={u:.0f}, p={p:.3g}")
else:
    print(f"  only {len(b)} long-target hits for the PXA module; individual values: {list(np.round(b,2))}")
print("\nSNX-RGS family named targets hit by the Nvj3 C-terminal query:")
snx=LONG[(LONG["query"]=="NVJ3_Cterm_254_463") & LONG.name.str.contains("nexin|Nexin|SNX",case=False,na=False)]
print(snx[["name","dbLen","tStart","tEnd","relmid","eval","tax"]].sort_values("eval").head(15).to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.5))
for i,(q,c,lab) in enumerate([("NVJ3_PXAmod_61_253","#2980b9","Nvj3 PXA module 61-253"),
                             ("NVJ3_Cterm_254_463","#c0392b","Nvj3 C-terminal half 254-463")]):
    s=LONG[LONG["query"]==q]
    ax.scatter(s.relmid, np.random.default_rng(i).normal(i,0.06,len(s)), color=c, alpha=0.7, s=35, label=f"{lab} (n={len(s)})")
ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["PXA module","C-terminal half"])
ax.set_xlabel("relative position of the alignment midpoint within the target protein (0 = N-terminus, 1 = C-terminus)")
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.axvline(0.2,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8); ax.axvline(0.85,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
ax.text(0.12,1.45,"PXA position",fontsize=8,color="grey"); ax.text(0.8,1.45,"PXC position",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper center"); ax.set_ylim(-0.5,1.7)
ax.set_title("Foldseek (afdb50): where each half of Nvj3 maps onto long SNX-RGS/Mdm1-like proteins",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nFoldseek pdb100 search: 0 hits for either Nvj3 half -> no experimental structure of a PXA or PXC fold exists in the PDB.")
